notes: This file is a machine-readable authoring-facing contract index for the current public DSL and high-frequency namespace helpers.
It describes the current public path, not every compatibility alias or historical syntax form.
When a symbol is missing here, prefer `syntax-rules.md`, `namespace-reference.md`, and verified examples before reading implementation code.

symbols.name: app
symbols.summary: Declare the app root and current `default_scene`.
authoring_notes: Multi-file apps should pair `default_scene` with `app_add_scene(scene = scene_ref(...))`.

symbols.name: app_add_scene
symbols.summary: Register an external scene file into the current app.
authoring_notes: Use this as the public multi-file scene registration path.
Do not treat `entry(...)` or `scene_file_ref(...)` as the default path.

symbols.name: scene_ref
symbols.summary: Reference a scene contract from an app owner slot, a template-like prop, or `scene_ref("self")` for the current scene contract.

symbols.name: frame.add_panel
symbols.summary: Append a panel block into the current frame layout.
authoring_notes: For named grid areas, keep `panel.area` aligned with `grid(areas=...)`.

symbols.name: panel_ref
symbols.summary: Clone or reuse a panel shell from another file, usually under `.stock/templates`.

symbols.name: metric_card_ref
symbols.summary: Clone or reuse a metric-card shell from another file, usually under `.stock/templates`.

symbols.name: dataset_ref
symbols.summary: Reference a dataset already visible in the current scene/world scope.

symbols.name: metric_ref
symbols.summary: Reference a metric already visible in the current scene/world scope.

symbols.name: resource_ref
symbols.summary: Reference a resource already visible in the current scene/world scope.

symbols.name: theme_ref
symbols.summary: Resolve a named theme from `.mei-config.json -> ops.themes`.
authoring_notes: Use a literal `theme = "cockpit"` when a built-in preset is enough.
Use `theme_ref(...)` when ops or deployment should control the theme value.

symbols.name: source_ref
symbols.summary: Resolve a named source from `.mei-config.json -> ops.sources`.
authoring_notes: Prefer this for upload-backed csv/xlsx sources.
This keeps data-source switching out of `.mei` code.

symbols.name: basemap_ref
symbols.summary: Resolve a named basemap from `.mei-config.json -> ops.basemaps`.

symbols.name: ops_param_ref
symbols.summary: Resolve a named ops parameter from `.mei-config.json -> ops.params`.
